column1: # Small Seal Script (小篆) codepoints (Unicode 18.0, U+3D000-U+3FC3F "Seal" block) mapped
# to their modern Han equivalent(s) -- one row per (seal codepoint, modern codepoint) pair,
# so a character with both an original and a simplified/variant spelling gets one row per
# spelling to the SAME seal glyph.  Columns: seal_cp, seal_char, han_char, note.
